link_defs.rule: The Sequence Number must be the Sequence Number contained in the original transaction request.

Element 5 (Approval Number): If it is included in a Purchase Request, then the Purchase Request is considered preauthorized (the completion carries the authorization's Approval Number - runtime link to the original's response, never invented).
A TOR must be sent from the same device as the original financial transaction request (applied to every follow-on and to the next transaction on the same device).
Follow-on carries the original's amount (TOR: requested amount; reversal: approved amount, p.84).

Required on reversals for matching information to the original
purchase. If it is included in a Purchase Request, then the
Purchase Request is considered preauthorized, and BUYPASS
does not go out for authorization. In the case of an Authorization Only Reversal, this element-
